label: Canopy

projection.consumedFor: sapling/program work cards, aggregate counts, typed gaps, freshness, graphVersion

lifecycleVocabulary.saplings: sapling status (draft/ready/active/blocked/paused/complete/retired), promotion (proof-only/supervised-branch/autonomous-branch), and current gate semantics

aggregates.total: count of projection work nodes whose canonical kind is sapling or program
aggregates.active: saplings whose canonical work status is exactly active (value.status === 'active'; currentState is never consulted), and programs whose canonical lifecycle is executing or verifying — ready/approved source lifecycles are mapped to status by the compiler (WORK_ACTIVE_STATES) and the renderer never second-guesses the projection
aggregates.blocked: work nodes whose canonical status is exactly blocked (value.status === 'blocked') for BOTH saplings and programs; ProgramWork.lifecycle has no blocked member, so lifecycle is never read for the blocked aggregate
aggregates.stale: work nodes whose workId is the subjectId of a typed stale gap only (stale-fence gaps name runs, not work objects)
aggregates.rules: deterministic mapping from canonical fields and typed gaps only; never title matching, never fabricated percentages

derivation.empty: no sapling or program work nodes in the projection
derivation.truncated: a section exceeds the 24-card canopy bound; overflow renders as an explicit typed state

density.bounds: cards stay bounded and stable-sorted by workId; overflow renders as a truncated state, never silent drops

authority.selection: selecting or opening a work object changes only local selectedWorkId, scene, and focus; zero lifecycle mutation, zero writes, zero extra authority decisions
authority.governedActions: any governed action delegates to the existing signed Gate client (POST /api/gate/{tenant}); the canopy slice renders read-only cues only

interactions.effect: local selectedWorkId set; scene navigates to mission; focus moves to the mission scene

accessibility.structure: sections aria-labelled Saplings and Programs; cards are articles with heading titles; the open-lineage control is a real button carrying the .of-tab class (the concrete min-height:44px rule) plus of-control/of-card-open, with visible focus via the .of-tab:focus-visible rule — .of-control alone is NOT sized
accessibility.announcements: aggregate counts render as text chips; empty/error/truncated states use role=status via the shared FabricState renderer

redaction: no initData, tokens, raw evidence refs, prompt material, or client payloads render; every projection-derived string passes the Task 7 escaping/fail-closed policy. The Node substrate embeds the canonical Task 7 signature regex VERBATIM (query_id=|auth_date=|\bhash=|Bearer\s|bot_token|clientSecret|initData|TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA|TG_INIT_DATA|QUESTS_PUSH_TOKEN|token=|PRIVATE KEY|\bprompt\s*[:=]|prompt\s+injection); the served browser substrate expresses the same policy as a legible normalized grammar — (?:query_id|auth_date|token)=|(?:^|\W)(?:hash)= plus the remaining explicit canonical terms — that keeps query_id/auth_date/token unanchored and the hash word boundary exactly like the canonical policy while never containing the contiguous raw-audit hash= literal; boolean equivalence is proven by a generated adversarial matrix (prefixes × assignment signatures × suffixes, case variants, benign near misses) with zero divergences; no character-class fragmentation, no split/concatenated forms
